title: Trump’s immigration raids continue through Halloween in Chicago and Los Angeles
summary: In Chicago suburb, protesters confronted ICE agents, whom Evanston mayor said ‘assaulted’ residents Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown continued on Halloween night as federal agents were seen in Chicago and Los Angeles on the holiday, according to multiple reports. In Chicago, where the president has unleashed military troops to assist Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) as agents carry out arrests and push back against protesters, several people were arrested on Friday. ICE agents descended on the city and its suburbs as part of their operations, and protesters were also detained during clashes with law enforcement. Continue reading...
